scope: T0 actual owning Go provider descriptor and private candidate snapshot projection via build-only overlay bridge. Candidate maps exercise absent manifests, absent adapter keys, null adapter entries, exact opaque generation/name lookup and private snapshot isolation; descriptor lookup uses the owning candidate capability definition. Adapter entries remain inert; connection/readiness/registry admission, actual activation and E2E generation affinity remain open. Raw descriptors, full active and private catalogs, generated edges and exact revision bytes compared.
